run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run (2026-11-21). The hard egress block seen on all recent runs persists and was re-tested this run: WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm and https://www.tenders.nsw.gov.au both returned DNS ENOTFOUND, so no buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened. Discovery was limited to WebSearch (US-indexed, lagging the 2026-11-21 run date, returning mostly cached snapshots, buyer-page snapshots, trade press and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 swept by search (AusTender; NSW buy.nsw/eTendering; VIC Buying for Victoria; QLD QTenders->VendorPanel/supply.qld.gov.au and Qld Health; WA Tenders WA/regional development-commission bulletins; SA Tenders SA; TAS Tenders Tasmania; NT QTOL; ACT Tenders). Tier 2 swept by search (Brisbane City Council; councils on VendorPanel; universities incl. University of Notre Dame Australia and James Cook University; GBEs incl. Australia Post, NBN Co, Transgrid, EnergyCo NSW and water corporations). Tier 3 MANDATORY check done by search (SAP Business Network Discovery / SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP GCMS, Rio Tinto Ariba, EstimateOne) - every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx; recorded as portals only, none fabricated. Net result this run: ONE genuinely new buyer-originated opportunity was captured at headline level (ACT Tenders RFT PIDC0014871, Digital Canberra, double-sourced via the Tenders ACT listing and an aggregator), and TWO new buyer-originated sources were recorded (EnergyCo NSW / NSW Electricity Infrastructure Roadmap tenders; Queensland Government Procurement Spend Portal). Four carryover opportunities were re-corroborated this run via buyer-page snapshots / trade press (DFAT-1113 PNG Health ENABLE managing-contractor REOI, DFAT business notification + DevelopmentAid updated 5 Nov, open; NSW ~$80M Master Media RFT closing 27 Nov 2026, strongly re-confirmed by B&T, Mediaweek, Mumbrella, Marketing-Interactive; Brisbane City Council Gardner Road Doc115483155 closing 7 Dec 2026 12 noon with enquiries to Michael Devitt and Prebble Street Bikeway Doc118000917 closing 11 Dec 2026 12 noon with enquiries to Corina Petre-Czibesz - both re-confirmed present on the BCC current-tenders page with contact names newly captured). Three carryovers were carried forward within their open window but NOT independently re-corroborated this run (TfNSW New England Hwy Maitland Westbound ROI 26.0000139291.0941.ROI closing 11 Dec; Tenders ACT SL20260630 and PIMA0014211). HONESTY NOTE: an initial NT QTOL WebSearch again surfaced a detailed set of December-closing NT tenders (AGC26-0118 advisory services; C11 Channel Island synchronous condenser; T26-1400 Peter McAulay Centre refurb; RFT0763 Power & Water incident management; T26-1062 lifts; T26-1246 MAGNT switchboard; NTG26-0127 vehicle rental; T26-1225 Alice Springs landscaping), but a targeted follow-up search could NOT re-corroborate AGC26-0118 or RFT0763 (it returned different/older PWC and AGC tender numbers) and NTG26-0127 carried a title conflict (vehicle rental vs aerial-photography/LiDAR on different snapshots). As on prior runs these NT items were therefore treated as an unverified search summary and were NOT captured as tenders (no fabrication of IDs, dates or scope); they are recorded in gaps. All 8 captured tenders remain headline-only and UNVERIFIED on an opened buyer page. No opportunity, deliverable, date, value or contact was fabricated.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged, re-tested this run): all direct HTTPS to tender hosts is denied by the session network policy. WebFetch to www.tenders.gov.au and www.tenders.nsw.gov.au both returned DNS ENOTFOUND this run, so no buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened. To restore full discovery these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au / info.buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.epw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, www.brisbane.qld.gov.au, www.energyco.nsw.gov.au, www.energy.nsw.gov.au, www.notredame.edu.au, and individual council/university/utility/corporate sites.

Every tender captured this run is headline-only and UNVERIFIED on the buyer's own opened page. Titles, reference numbers, closing dates and (for Brisbane) contact names come from WebSearch snapshots of buyer pages, trade press and aggregators, not from an opened buyer detail page or an opened ATM. Deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation criteria, submission mechanics, value and most contacts are therefore null and still need a detail pass once egress is restored.

NT QTOL: a WebSearch of tendersonline.nt.gov.au surfaced a detailed set of December-closing NT tenders (AGC26-0118 Professional Advisory Services 36 months closing 16/12; C11 Channel Island Power Station Synchronous Condenser D&C closing 17/12; T26-1400 Peter McAulay Centre office refurbishment D&C closing 07/12; RFT0763 Power & Water Emergency Operations/Business Continuity Incident Management System closing 11/12; T26-1062 lift repairs/maintenance 36 months closing 10/12; T26-1246 MAGNT main switchboard replacement closing 09/12; NTG26-0127 vehicle rental 60 months closing 08/12; T26-1225 Alice Springs medians/verges/landscaping 36 months closing 07/12). A targeted follow-up search could NOT re-corroborate AGC26-0118 or RFT0763 (it returned different/older PWC tenders RFT0575/0577/0589/0715 and an older AGC21-0265), and NTG26-0127 appeared with a conflicting title (vehicle rental vs aerial-photography/LiDAR). To avoid asserting unverified IDs/dates/scope these NT items were NOT captured as tenders (egress block prevented opening the QTOL records). The QTOL portal is clearly active with many current 'Details' records and a Forward Tender Outlook; these need verification on the live site once egress is restored.

ACT: additional new Tenders ACT references surfaced this run in a single cached listing snapshot but could NOT be re-corroborated and were NOT captured: PICE0014931 (City and Environment Directorate EOI, reported released 5 Nov, closing 10 Dec 2026); PIED0011391 (Education Directorate RFT, reported released 11 Nov, closing 10 Dec 2026 - a targeted follow-up search could not re-find this reference); PICH0008972 (Canberra Health Services RFT, reported released 12 Nov, closing 10 Dec 2026). These are recorded here for verification on the live portal; only PIDC0014871 (double-sourced) was captured as a tender.

Three carryover opportunities were NOT independently re-corroborated this run and are asserted only as still within their open window: TfNSW New England Hwy Maitland Westbound ROI (26.0000139291.0941.ROI, closing 11 Dec) and the two Tenders ACT entries (SL20260630; PIMA0014211 closing 3 Dec). The Tenders ACT SL20260630 close date remains in conflict across snapshots (1 Dec vs 3 Dec) and must be confirmed on the live portal once egress is restored.

ACT PIDC0014871 (Digital Canberra RFT, captured this run) is headline-only and carries two residual uncertainties to resolve on the live portal: (a) the release 16 Nov / close 11 Dec 2026 2:00pm dates sat in an ambiguous block that could belong to a neighbouring listing (PIHD0007322); and (b) an aggregator labelled the related 'Digital Canberra Data Centre Services for ACT Government' procurement as 'Current Invited', so it may be a select/invited rather than fully open tender.

WebSearch index lags the run date (2026-11-21) and is US-indexed. Many surfaced notices had already closed (e.g. multiple Victoria Gippsland Water/Latrobe Regional Health items closing 17-20 Nov; University of Wollongong student financial counselling UOW2026_0169 closed 19 Oct; various NT civil tenders) and were correctly excluded, NOT captured. Genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network Discovery / SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP GCMS, Rio Tinto Ariba, EstimateOne subcontractor packages, and major retail/bank/telco/energy e-sourcing hubs) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tender fabricated. Management-consultancy / invitation-only RFPs are out of scope by definition and were not invented.

University of Notre Dame Australia 'Managed Security Operations Centre (SOC) Services' RFT has a specific buyer page (notredame.edu.au/staff/support/finance/procurement/suppliers/rft-managed-security-operations-centre-soc-services) but its dates/status could not be confirmed (egress block), so it was recorded as a source only and NOT captured as a tender.

tenders.title: PNG Health Program - Enhanced National Advice, Bilateral partnership, and Learning and Evidence (ENABLE) - Managing Contractor
tenders.buyer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
tenders.category: Managing contractor services - international development / health systems
tenders.description: DFAT Request for Expressions of Interest to appoint a Managing Contractor for the PNG Health Program 'ENABLE' (Enhanced National Advice, Bilateral partnership, and Learning and Evidence), a new Australian health investment in Papua New Guinea expected to commence in 2027 for an initial five-year term. The REOI stage is to establish a shortlist of capable organisations, which would then be invited to a subsequent request-for-tender stage.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Per DFAT's public concept note and development page, the Managing Contractor would deliver selected national-level enabling functions and strategic partnerships that support Australia's broader health portfolio in PNG and integrated primary health care - aligning national policy, financing, evidence and partnership functions with Australia's health investments under the PNG-Australia Health Partnership Strategy, and supporting delivery of quality health services including disease-outbreak containment. (Drawn from DFAT's published concept note read via search; full deliverables to be confirmed on the opened ATM.)
tenders.scope_of_work: ENABLE is positioned as delivering national enabling functions (policy, financing, evidence/learning, and partnership/coordination) and strategic partnerships supporting the PNG-Australia Health Partnership Strategy and integrated primary health care, delivered through a managing contractor over an initial five-year term from 2027. Full scope to be confirmed from the ATM documents.
tenders.eligibility: Open REOI to establish a shortlist of capable organisations able to deliver the program (not verified on the opened ATM this run).
tenders.contract_term: Initial five-year term (program expected to commence 2027), per DFAT concept note
tenders.closing_time: 10:00 AM ACT time (per aggregator snapshot; not verified on ATM)
tenders.submission_method: Lodge via AusTender (not verified on the opened ATM this run)
tenders.reasoning: Carryover (first seen 2026-11-19) re-corroborated this run (2026-11-21) via WebSearch of DFAT's own development/business-notification pages (dfat.gov.au/development/managing-contractor-png-health-program-...-enable) and a DevelopmentAid listing last updated 5 Nov 2026 showing the ENABLE managing-contractor procurement as open and at the stage of establishing a shortlist of capable organisations. Buyer-originated Commonwealth channel (DFAT via AusTender); the AusTender ATM itself could not be opened due to the persistent egress block.
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-ONLY and UNVERIFIED on the opened ATM. Reference (DFAT-1113), publish (~5 Nov 2026) and close (1 Dec 2026, 10:00am ACT) come from DFAT's own pages plus an aggregator snapshot, not an opened AusTender record; the exact close date was not re-confirmed on the ATM this run. Scope/deliverables text is from DFAT's public concept note read via search; evaluation criteria, documents, value and contacts still null and need a detail pass once egress is restored. Re-corroborated as still open this run (2026-11-21).
